claim: *Three correspondence patterns.* Derive where implementation is the source of truth; generate where the model is the source of truth; otherwise maintain traceability and check the correspondences that are decidable.

topology.description: Three peer columns: upward derivation, downward generation, bidirectional decidable check.

bw_encoding: One consistent 8% model role across all three comparisons; implementation/system peers white.
redesign: One consistent 8% model role across all three comparisons; implementation/system peers white. Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
alt: Three peer columns distinguish direction of authority. Derive points upward from implementation to model; generate points downward from model to implementation or configuration; trace and check links model and system in both directions. Only decidable correspondences are checked when neither side fully determines the other.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Gray model tier contrasts with implementation/system tier; upward, downward and bidirectional relations retained.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors

style_review.fill: One consistent 8% model role across all three comparisons; implementation/system peers white.
style_review.bold: Bold restricted to panel/container headings; ordinary node labels and explanatory text regular.
style_review.routing: Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Original source and candidate semantics compared; final-size native render inspected for fill, hierarchy, routes and legibility.
